preview.mockQuestion: Does my chatbot have to tell users they're talking to an AI?
preview.mockAnswer: Yes. Article 50(1) of the AI Act sets a transparency obligation: AI systems intended to interact with natural persons must inform them that they are communicating with an AI, unless this is obvious from the context.
